title: Profit-Pool Quality Candidate V2
derivesFrom: Cross-holdout contrast between 2017 Xianhe and 2019 Hudian; must not be validated on those cases.
purpose: Test whether the quality of a newly material profit pool is better described by operating conversion, repeatability and cash economics than by nominal order/revenue size alone.

dimensions.name: operating_conversion
dimensions.question: Before selection, is the new pool already visible in reported recurring revenue, gross margin, operating profit or cash flow rather than only an announced contract or TAM?

dimensions.name: repeatability_duration
dimensions.question: Is demand likely to recur across customers/periods or is it one-off/lumpy?

dimensions.name: cash_economics
dimensions.question: Are margin, working-capital, collection and capex requirements good enough for the new revenue to become value?

dimensions.name: consolidated_materiality
dimensions.question: Can the pool become large enough to change consolidated earnings sensitivity without being offset by weaker legacy segments?

dimensions.name: expectation_absorption
dimensions.question: How much of the pool is already embedded in price and consensus?

rules: No dimension is a hard gate.
Do not infer states from later returns.
Single-contract size alone cannot establish high profit-pool quality.
A known macro/cycle opportunity remains eligible if direct economics and expectation asymmetry are attractive.
validationRequirement: Test unchanged on an untouched historical window plus prospective samples before any production adoption.
